user.title: Add an Echo running hassmic
user.description: Its address on your network (the settings page's, without the port). Home Assistant then asks the Echo to let it in.

reauth_confirm.title: Let Home Assistant in again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer knows Home Assistant (a factory reset, or its login revoked on the settings page). Submit, then press the button on the Echo.

confirm.title: {name}
confirm.description: Add the alarms of {name}? You will press a button on it next.

approve.title: Press the button on {name}
approve.description: {name} now waits for Home Assistant to be let in, as a browser is let into its settings page: press {button} within a minute, then Submit.

error.cannot_connect: The Echo did not answer at that address.
error.not_approved: Not let in yet: press the button on the Echo, then Submit again.
error.refused: The Echo turned the request down (another login at the same moment?). It asks again now: press the button, then Submit.

abort.reauth_successful: Home Assistant is let in again.

add_alarm.name: Add alarm
add_alarm.description: Adds an alarm to an Echo running hassmic. It rings on the Echo, with or without Home Assistant.

device_id.name: Echo
device_id.description: Which Echo (not needed with only one).

days.name: Days
days.description: Days it repeats on (mon, tue, ...); none: once, the next time it comes.

label.name: Label
label.description: What it is for: shown and announced instead of the time.

enabled.name: On
enabled.description: Off: kept, but it does not ring.

edit_alarm.name: Edit alarm
edit_alarm.description: Changes an alarm (its switch entity). An edited alarm is switched on unless you say otherwise.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days it repeats on; an empty list: once.

enabled.name: On
enabled.description: Off: kept, but it does not ring.

delete_alarm.name: Delete alarm
delete_alarm.description: Deletes an alarm (its switch entity) from the Echo.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Snoozes the alarm ringing on an Echo.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops what rings on an Echo, alarms and timers.
